witness.branch: Marked-crosswalk passage on an alley travel route
witness.quote: Pedestrians shall move whenever practicable upon the right half of crosswalks.
witness.reason: An alley travel route can include a distinctly marked highway crosswalk; an alley junction need not qualify as an intersection.
required_context: Construct an afoot route moving upon a distinctly marked highway crosswalk connected to the alley travel route.
Establish crosswalk placement, associated signals, route access and approach relationships.
Leave practicability and the method of legally determining the right half unresolved; no lateral-offset or congestion threshold is supplied.
Retain passage space, obstacles and other pedestrians throughout movement.
Retain pedestrian direction, position, passage space, obstacles and other participants throughout passage.
Specify the marked highway crossing, boundaries, accessible connection to the alley route and any associated signals.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian actor is a person afoot moving upon the crosswalk.
